items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Square YoRHa avatar frame on Base UI Avatar: image layer plus initials fallback, hairline border, no radius.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Compose Avatar, AvatarImage (alt required), AvatarFallback. v4: AvatarStatus (online/away/busy/offline: disc/diamond/square/ring glyph in a 12 px corner box, named for screen readers) and AvatarGroup (overlap by a hairline, +N overflow avatar, size applied to children).
